tools.name: get_platform_stats
tools.description: Return current PhishDestroy report-database counters with metric definitions and source timestamps.

tools.name: get_cti_stats
tools.description: Return CTI aggregates. Confirmed takedowns and latest-check unavailability are separate fields.

tools.name: get_domain_report
tools.description: Return the stored evidence record for one domain, including dated detections and report links. With detail (summary, evidence or full), sections, max_chars or cursor it returns the compact phishdestroy.domain-report.v1 structure instead: record status (listed, not_found, removed, withdrawn), the Phi

tools.name: lookup_domains
tools.description: Check up to 25 domains in one call: record status per domain (listed, not_found, removed, withdrawn) with the report URL, first-recorded time and confirmed takedown. not_found is not a safety verdict. Unicode names, URLs and defanged [.] input are normalised; invalid entries are listed separately. F

tools.name: probe_domain
tools.description: Run a rate-limited live HTTP probe for a public domain. The result is liveness evidence, not a safety verdict.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search published PhishDestroy domain reports by a domain (exact; URLs and defanged input accepted), the start of a domain name (3+ characters) or an impersonated brand as stored (e.g. Coinbase, MetaMask). Returns up to 20 results (id = domain, title with the first-recorded date, url = report page),

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one PhishDestroy domain report found with search (id = domain): record status, assessment, third-party verdicts with dates, availability, takedown and evidence links, as text and JSON (phishdestroy.domain-report.v1, detail summary).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
